items.html: Know that the principal illumination that Arich Anpin gives to Zeir Anpin is from that one other path that runs in the middle of the hair of Arich Anpin, as mentioned in Idra Rabba, page 129, side A, and page 136, side A. And this one alone is drawn continuously to the head of Zeir Anpin, through one of his own paths that is also in the middle of the hair of Zeir Anpin. And he has no suckling from the thirteen whitenesses mentioned, only from the thirteen locks of hair, from the four that are at the back of the head of Arich Anpin, as mentioned in the chapter after this one. But the righteous inherit the shining of their [light] from these four whitenesses that are drawn at the back of the head of Arich Anpin.
